Derrick Henry is RB1, don't let this indicate anything otherwise, but Justice Hill has always been the passing down back. Hill has a 53% route share this season but Henry has a 68% rush attempt share. So, more passing downs means more Justice Hill snaps.

The second aspect of this is the tendencies of Joe Fagnano because Lamar and Huntley can both use their legs and extend plays, or run for first downs themselves if the defense drops too deep. Fagnano however, does not have much mobility, so he is significantly more likely to check it down to the RB in the flat.

A lot of his prospect analysis say the same thing: He does not have a great arm or takes big risks, but he goes through his progressions quick and takes care of the ball. Considering the checkdown is the safest play more often than not, and it is not usually the first read, these are traits that favor RB checkdowns big time.
